assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: corrective action - key safeguard at P-4104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-4104 and PT-4104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. P-4104 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 9 May 2005 a corrective action on P-4104 and PT-4104 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the key safeguard it was raised to restore.
